title: Duality of Linear Programs
description: Quick check on weak/strong duality and the primal-dual relationship.

questions.prompt: If there is a maximising LP with $\text{OPT}_1$ and a corresponding dual with $\text{OPT}_2$, what is the name of the inequality connecting $\text{OPT}_1$ with $\text{OPT}_2$?
Which of the following are correct? (A primal LP has optimum $\text{OPT}_1$ and its corresponding dual has optimum $\text{OPT}_2$.)
If there is a maximising LP with $\text{OPT}_1$ and a corresponding dual with $\text{OPT}_2$, what is the name of the property asserting $\text{OPT}_1 = \text{OPT}_2$?
Given a primal LP and its corresponding dual, is the dual of the dual the same as the primal? (True / False)
What do the variables in the primal correspond to in the dual?
What do the constraints in the primal correspond to in the dual?
